items.title: 🎥 'Tangles' director calls animated film 'a love letter to caregivers'
items.author: Reuters
items.content:
<article>Director Leah Nelson's feature debut "Tangles" brings Sarah Leavitt's graphic memoir, "Tangles: A Story About Alzheimer's, My Mother and Me," to the big screen in black-and-white, hand-drawn 2D animation.
 
Nelson, who has dealt with dementia in her own family, hopes caregivers will feel seen through the film. Actor Abbi Jacobson, whose grandmother had Alzheimer's, said it's important for people to see their experiences reflected on screen.
 
#Alzheimers #Film #TIFF #Movie</article>
